readback.name: Poincare.hasFDerivAt_neg_norm_sq_div
readback.mathematical_statement: For an arbitrary-universe real inner-product space E with NormedAddCommGroup and InnerProductSpace Real instances, every real t != 0 and x in E, the map y -> -||y||^2/(4t) has Frechet derivative at x given by the continuous linear functional v -> -<x,v>/(2t). No finite dimension or completeness is assumed; negative t is permitted. No supplied flow or manifold geometry occurs.

readback.name: Poincare.hasFDerivAt_exp_neg_norm_sq_div
readback.mathematical_statement: For an arbitrary-universe real inner-product space E with the stated normed additive and real inner-product instances, every real t != 0 and x in E, the map G_t(y)=exp(-||y||^2/(4t)) has Frechet derivative at x given by v -> G_t(x)*(-<x,v>/(2t)). No finite dimension or completeness is assumed; negative t is permitted. No supplied flow or manifold geometry occurs.

readback.name: Poincare.iteratedFDeriv_two_exp_neg_norm_sq_div_apply
readback.mathematical_statement: For an arbitrary-universe real inner-product space E, every real t != 0 and x,v in E, iteratedFDeriv Real 2 of G_t(y)=exp(-||y||^2/(4t)) at x, applied to the ordered pair (v,v), equals G_t(x)*(<x,v>^2/(4t^2)-||v||^2/(2t)). This is the diagonal Hessian evaluation, not a separately stated mixed two-direction or time derivative formula. No finite dimension or completeness is assumed; negative t is permitted. No supplied flow or manifold geometry occurs.

readback.name: Poincare.sum_sq_inner_stdOrthonormalBasis
readback.mathematical_statement: For an arbitrary-universe finite-dimensional real inner-product space E and every x in E, the finite sum of <x,e_i>^2 over i:Fin(finrank Real E), where e_i is Mathlib's stdOrthonormalBasis Real E, equals ||x||^2. Zero dimension is allowed. There is no time parameter or supplied flow/manifold geometry.

readback.name: Poincare.laplacian_exp_neg_norm_sq_div
readback.mathematical_statement: For an arbitrary-universe finite-dimensional real inner-product space E, every real t != 0 and x in E, the canonical positive-sign inner-product-space Laplacian of G_t(y)=exp(-||y||^2/(4t)) at x equals G_t(x)*(||x||^2/(4t^2)-(finrank Real E coerced to Real)/(2t)). Negative t and zero-dimensional E are allowed. This is the spatial Laplacian of the unnormalized exponential, with no manifold Laplace-Beltrami operator or supplied global flow.

readback.name: Poincare.heatKernel_heatEquation_laplacian
readback.mathematical_statement: For an arbitrary-universe finite-dimensional real inner-product space E, every positive real t and x in E, deriv(tau -> heatKernel tau x) at t equals the canonical positive-sign inner-product-space Laplacian of y -> heatKernel t y at x, where the pinned definition is heatKernel t x=(4*pi*t)^(-n/2)*exp(-||x||^2/(4t)) and n=finrank Real E. This is a pointwise positive-time derivative-operator equality for the explicit Gaussian. The frozen type supplies only the space instances and t>0; it does not separately package initial delta data, mass-one integration, uniqueness, joint regularity, manifold heat-kernel existence, or global geometric-flow existence.
